Pb.materiality_basis: marcelis2024 (full-panel screen incl. Al and Sn across tampons, pads, cups and other intimate products)
Pb.rationale: Lead is present in this device class per routed occurrence evidence (marcelis2024 (full-panel screen incl. Al and Sn across tampons, pads, cups and other intimate products)); no jurisdiction sets a Lead content limit for a menstrual or intimate-care device (medical-device law governs ISO 10993 biocompatibility, not content). The cell is held under mandatory analytical control, not declared not-material — a not-material determination would be contradicted by the occurrence evidence and would fail the substantiation gate.
Pb.reference_method: Mandatory per-lot total-content analysis by microwave-assisted acid digestion and ICP-MS, with component-level sampling of the finished article (each material component sampled and tested distinctly; the catch-all defaults to the stricter applicable method until classified). No sovereign sets a heavy-metal content limit for this device form, so no fixed numeric ceiling is published; any lot result is dispositioned under the HMTc control-and-escalation rule (ALARA tightening against the tightest available context + supplier corrective action). Lead is material for this device (full-panel screen measured across intimate products in the routed corpus (marcelis2024)).

MeHg.rationale: Methylmercury forms by microbial methylation in aquatic food webs and bioaccumulates in fish muscle; a cellulose/polymer intimate device has no methylation pathway and no dietary mercury source. Intimate-product metal surveys measure TOTAL mercury, not methylmercury, so no routed source reports methylmercury (the not-material integrity gate is speciation-aware). Any mercury present is governed by and bounded by the total-mercury control/ceiling. No jurisdiction sets a methylmercury limit for a menstrual or intimate-care product.
MeHg.regulatory_basis: No MeHg ML for any menstrual/intimate-care product in any jurisdiction; methylmercury MLs are scoped to fish and seafood only.
MeHg.jurisdictions_checked: 21 CFR 884 & EU MDR 2017/745 (device biocompatibility, no content ML); Germany BVL 2017, Health Canada, China NMPA 2015, ASEAN 2019, Korea MFDS 2024/2025, FDA 21 CFR 700 (cosmetic contaminant limits — none set MeHg)

Sb is OUTSIDE the 10-analyte HMTc certification panel; its inclusion for polymer intimate devices is logged as a Step-0 panel-governance question.
